## 🚀 Setup Complete!

1. Go to: https://github.com/aadiigupta25-code/sochio-mobile-flutter-app/settings/secrets/actions
2. Click "New repository secret"
3. Add each secret above
4. Push any code change to trigger automated build

Your Android builds will now be generated automatically on every push!
